scope: The sole inherited behavior expectation changed is the explicitly obsolete valid repeated-save overwrite. Current expectation retains original group, then asserts a fresh nonrepeat key saves new selection. Original file remains hash-locked. No cases removed, no DOM projection changes.
diff: for(const mode of ['prestart','restart','terminal'])for(const kind of ['ctrl','meta','ctrl-click','button'])test(mode+' blocks '+kind,()=>{const g=fresh();g.run(mode==='prestart'?'state.started=false;updateUI()':mode==='restart'?'restartPrompt=true;updateUI()':'state.result="fixture terminal";updateUI()');const before=world(g,true);route(g,0,kind);eq(world(g,true),before,'blocked lifecycle makes no change or feedback');g.run('controlGroup(0,true)');eq(world(g,true),before,'central command guard blocks direct save')});

for(const kind of ['ctrl','meta','ctrl-click','button'])test('paused '+kind+' save and recall',()=>{const g=fresh();g.click('pause');g.run('selection=new Set([8]);updateUI()');route(g,0,kind);eq(g.run('groups[0]'),[8],'paused save remains allowed');g.run('selection.clear()');key(g,0,{ctrlKey:false});eq(g.run('[...selection]'),[8],'paused recall remains allowed');ok(g.state.paused,'pause retained')});

for(const [label,extra,focus]of [['input',{},'coordinateCommandX'],['select',{},'gameSpeed'],['composition',{isComposing:true}],['IME229',{keyCode:229}],['alt',{altKey:true}],['editable',{},'log']])test('keyboard boundary '+label,()=>{const g=fresh();g.run('selection=new Set([8]);updateUI()');if(focus){g.element(focus).focus();if(label==='editable')g.element(focus).isContentEditable=true}const before=world(g,true);eq(key(g,0,extra),false,'non-game input not consumed');eq(world(g,true),before,'non-game input leaves groups')});

-test('repeat rejects empty without losing group; later valid repeated save stays supported',()=>{const g=fresh();g.run('selection.clear()');for(let n=0;n<3;n++)key(g,0,{repeat:true});eq(g.run('groups[0]'),[6,7],'repeated empty key preserves group');g.run('selection=new Set([8])');key(g,0,{repeat:true});eq(g.run('groups[0]'),[8],'valid repeat behavior unchanged')});

+test('repeat preserves group with empty or valid selection; fresh save still works',()=>{const g=fresh();g.run('selection.clear()');for(let n=0;n<3;n++)key(g,0,{repeat:true});eq(g.run('groups[0]'),[6,7],'repeated empty key preserves group');g.run('selection=new Set([8])');key(g,0,{repeat:true});eq(g.run('groups[0]'),[6,7],'valid repeat intentionally ignored');key(g,0,{repeat:false});eq(g.run('groups[0]'),[8],'fresh save behavior unchanged')});

test('disabled visible save and stale onclick remain no-op',()=>{const g=fresh(),handler=g.element('saveControlGroup0').onclick;g.run('selection.clear();updateUI()');const before=world(g,true);g.click('saveControlGroup0');handler();eq(world(g,true),before,'visible invalid save keeps existing no-op feedback semantics')});

test('recall survivors and cancellation semantics unchanged',()=>{const g=fresh();g.run('state.entities=state.entities.filter(e=>e.id!==7);groups[0]=[6,7,17,99999];selection=new Set([8]);placement="power";attackMode=true;ordinaryCommandMode=true;appendCommandMode=true;drag={x:1};');const state=JSON.stringify(g.state);key(g,0,{ctrlKey:false});eq(g.run('[...selection]'),[6],'recall selects existing friendly survivors');eq(JSON.stringify(g.state),state,'recall does not change simulation commands');eq(g.run('[placement,attackMode,ordinaryCommandMode,appendCommandMode,drag]'),[null,false,false,false,null],'existing recall mode cancellation');eq(g.run('groups[0]'),[6,7,17,99999],'recall does not rewrite membership')});

test('natural map selection and actual key click routing preserve saved tanks',()=>{const g=loadGame(source,{seed:29002}).start();g.click('pause');for(const id of [6,7]){const e=g.state.entities.find(e=>e.id===id);map(g,e.x,e.y,id===7);}eq(g.run('[...selection]'),[6,7],'natural two-tank selection');route(g,0,'ctrl');eq(g.run('groups[0]'),[6,7],'natural key saves tanks');const factory=g.state.entities.find(e=>e.team===0&&e.type==='factory');map(g,factory.x,factory.y);eq(g.run('[...selection]'),[factory.id],'natural building selection');route(g,0,'meta');eq(g.run('groups[0]'),[6,7],'natural building save preserves tanks');map(g,50,50);eq(g.run('selection.size'),0,'natural empty ground clears selection');route(g,0,'ctrl-click');eq(g.run('groups[0]'),[6,7],'natural empty click save preserves tanks');key(g,0,{ctrlKey:false});eq(g.run('[...selection]'),[6,7],'natural recall still works')});
